serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I can’t believe Big Daddy really told me to do this…
My hands are shaking and my head hurts…
I don’t even have time to think about this…{{wi}} I need to call that freak asap or else he might start suspecting something.
You: It’s me. Cops are gone.
???: …
You: Where should I go?
???: Don’t you EVER hang up on me you DUMB FUCK! {{punch}}
???: Try disobeying orders one more time and you are done for!
You: Ok…
I guess this is how they really are… a bunch of violent criminals…
???: Did you look inside the package?
You: N-no? W-why would I?
???: Well, you had a lot of free time.
???: Just in case you did look inside. Do not tell anyone about it. Especially Richard.
No wonder. Most of the people reading the blog are clueless about this.
You: Well, I didn’t look inside it so it won’t be needed.
???: I will believe you for now, but don’t do anything on your own ever again.
???: Go straight down the street. In about 100 feet turn left…
